pattern_explanation: These Turkish words were borrowed from French, and their English look-alikes came from the same French source, but over time the meanings drifted apart in each language, so the forms look close while the meanings differ.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish words transliterated as sempatik, etiket, aktuel and entrika look close to the English words sympathetic, etiquette, actual and intrigue, but they mean likeable, label, current and plot, so a learner who trusts the similar form will choose the wrong meaning.
